title: How beavers reshape entire river ecosystems
hook: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.

scenes.narration: Beavers live in freshwater ecosystems such as rivers, streams, lakes and ponds.
In Europe, beavers were reduced to fragmented populations, with combined population numbers being estimated at limited individuals.
The concept became popular in conservation, and was deployed in a range of contexts and mobilized to engender support.
In addition, wolves often kept animals from grazing in riparian areas, which protected beavers from having food sources encroached upon.
The connectivity of streams to their adjacent floodplain along their entire length plays an important role in the equilibrium.
Stream restoration or river restoration, sometimes called river reclamation, is a set of activities that aim to improve environmental health.
Human activities had damaged ecosystems, such as by removing keystone predators from the natural landscape.
Combined population numbers for these animals remained restricted to specific locations across the European continent.
